slides.title: Program Performance: Executive Summary
slides.summary: topcashback performance was mixed in Jan 2026 – Apr 2026. Conversions moved +30.0% to 130 and conversion rate moved +25.0% to 5.0%. Publisher commission increased +11.1% to GBP 1,000, while digital wallet earnings increased +20.8% to GBP 145. Total earnings ended at GBP 1,145 (+12.3%) and total order value increased +30.0% to GBP 13,000.

slides.title: KPI Highlights & Business Implications
slides.subtitle: What the numbers mean for the business - key signals and context.
bullets: Conversion Rate Movement: Conversion rate increased +25.0% (4.0% to 5.0%). Conversions increased +30.0% (30), showing how efficiently the publisher converted traffic into outcomes.
Conversion Volume: Total conversions increased +30.0% (30). Largest declining publisher contribution requires confirmation from mover tables.
Order Value: Total order value increased +30.0% (GBP 10,000 to GBP 13,000). Value generation moved alongside conversion volume and earnings performance.
Publisher Commission: Publisher commission increased +11.1% (GBP 900 to GBP 1,000). Commission remains the core publisher earning component.
Total Earnings: Total earnings increased +12.3% (GBP 1,020 to GBP 1,145). Digital wallet contribution was GBP 145 (+20.8%), so total earnings combine commission and wallet income.
